obligations.expected_behavior: When derived evidence is generated, it explicitly declares an empty authorization set.
forbidden_result: The authorization set declaration is omitted.
obligations.observable_result: The generated derived evidence contains an authorization-set field whose value is empty.
obligations.state_after: Derived evidence records an empty authorization set.
obligations.state_before: Derived evidence is being generated and its authorization set has not yet been declared.
obligations.subject: Derived evidence authorization declaration

obligations.expected_behavior: A lifecycle publication originating from a foreign lifecycle context is rejected.
forbidden_result: The foreign lifecycle publication is accepted as valid.
obligations.observable_result: The publication attempt returns a failure outcome and no successful publication is recorded.
obligations.state_after: The foreign lifecycle publication has failed.
obligations.state_before: A foreign lifecycle publication is being attempted and its outcome is undecided.
obligations.subject: Lifecycle publication authorization
obligations.trigger: Attempt to publish through a foreign lifecycle context

obligations.expected_behavior: Acceptance advances only when both a current independent review and the proper lifecycle owner authorize the advancement.
forbidden_result: Acceptance advances without a current independent review.
Acceptance advances without the proper lifecycle owner.
Acceptance advances when either authorization condition is stale, invalid, or absent.
obligations.observable_result: An Acceptance advancement occurs if and only if current independent review and proper lifecycle ownership are both present; otherwise Acceptance remains unchanged.
obligations.state_after: Acceptance is advanced only after both required authorization conditions are satisfied, or remains unchanged when either is not satisfied.
obligations.state_before: An Acceptance advancement request is pending verification of review currency and lifecycle ownership.
obligations.subject: Acceptance advancement authorization
